content: {"promos": [{"title": "Cruel Offer to Villainess", "start_block": "B026", "end_block": "B053", "hook": "A fallen noblewoman begs for mercy on the muddy courtyard, only for the Duke's wife to offer her a humiliating job as a scullery maid.", "cliffhanger": "Juliana stares unflinchingly at Catherine and declares, 'As a scullery maid.'", "why": "The visual of a fallen villainess kneeling in the mud contrasted with the new Duchess's cold, authoritative offer creates immediate tension and a clear power shift.", "context_gap": "A stranger would not know that Catherine is the villainess who tried to destroy Juliana, nor that Juliana is the new Duchess."}, {"title": "Wife's Cruel Justice", "start_block": "B047", "end_block": "B063", "hook": "The new Duchess steps past her husband to confront the fallen noblewoman, extending a rough servant's apron and demanding she scrub the manor hearths.", "cliffhanger": "Juliana holds the keys to Catherine's fate and warns, 'One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing.'", "why": "This is the episode's climax, showcasing the protagonist's agency and the villainess's total humiliation, ending on a high-stakes ultimatum.", "context_gap": "A stranger would not understand the history of betrayal between the two women or the specific terms of Catherine's servitude."}, {"title": "Husband's Vow of Protection", "start_block": "B011", "end_block": "B024", "hook": "The Duke's wife trembles with fear about the High Council, but her scarred husband firmly clasps her hands and vows they will stand before the King again.", "cliffhanger": "Alexander declares, 'You are my wife. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that.'", "why": "It establishes the couple's bond against the odds and sets up the looming ten-day trial mentioned in the previous episode.", "context_gap": "A stranger would not know that their marriage was just declared invalid by a High Priest."}], "moments": [{"start_block": "B026", "end_block": "B028", "kind": "hook", "description": "Lady Ashbourne glares down at Catherine kneeling in the mud and asks, 'You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?'}]}
